page.overview:
Who is Kiku?

Kiku is a member of the Kuja. She is never seen but her name appears on the match-ups of the arena battle board.

Little is known about Kiku's abilities, but, since her odds of winning were 5:1, it can be presumed that she is weaker than her opponent, Shion.

Kiku's name was seen on the list of match-ups in the arena battles. She was listed against Shion.
